keySentence: Mary found a secret and locked garden.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mary opened the hidden door. The garden was wild and messy. But Mary was excited. Mary found a secret and locked garden.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mary pushed open the old door and stepped inside carefully. The garden had been locked and forgotten for ten long years. Weeds grew everywhere and the roses had stopped blooming. Mary found a secret and locked garden that needed her help. She wondered why someone had locked this beautiful place away. Mary decided right then that she would bring it back to life.
